title: Face care in a box
text: [[VIDEOID:3ab566b5d19c5ad26b1e491a4189ffec]] The box was okay, the value was fair. Inside the box had 6 products for your face. A face wash, face scrub, face mask, single face mask, hair serum and rose water spray. I will try a second box to see if I would continue with my subscription.  I was hoping to get skin care or hair care products. The box contains products for your face. All the products were from brand named Reshma.
label: positive
